notes.title: Chapter 2 is live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=HkGtEEC1Hr0;full][/previewyoutube]

Chapter 2 Eura Village is available now! 

After the Rauhan Wall defense, The Dark King Thormentor decides to hunt down the invaders and takes his bodyguards Draco and Anika with him! 

Play as the Dark King Thormentor to defeat all the enemies! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34386777/88960d02ec00235ae6b352fdb23e1cda95a76229.jpg

Draco goes North of the map and Anika goes South of the map, you can follow one of them or explore the map your own way. 

You can also accept the Ice Queen Vera help by allowing ICE Golems to follow you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34386777/5b8098d9140bd6882f353a565df8867ca3f4ec14.jpg

The Chapter 2 is full of surprises and hard final boss! remember to use the crossbow!

Some fixes-additions
*Dark elf crossbow bolts cause basic reaction instead of only penetrate to most enemies, some bosses are unaffected
*More pain screams by the evil pagans when they die.
*More ranged enemies, some enemies will use ranged weapons or spells
*New ally revealed - Dark Ranger!

Known issue
Grenades do not always work properly, use grenades by not holding any weapon like swords or crossbow, with "G" key.

Well, that's all for now! I hope you enjoy this Chapter as much as I do! :D because I truly believe is fun! and more hard to beat!

Thank you for buying the game and for your support it means a lot for me! God Bless you all brothers! DEUS VULT!

notes.title: READ GUIDE! before you play! :D
notes.content:
Hello Templars!	
https://i.imgur.com/gmm1J6C.jpg

I have seen people play and the only ones failing to complete the game are the ones that do not read the GUIDE or watch VIDEO tutorial.

 Here are the most important things to do in game:
1.-Get Green Potions to recover Health!
2.-Always have your guard up "shield up" by pressing left shift
3.-Enemies can break defense if more than 2 attack at the same time
4.-If you die and have no health potions, then is game over. Press "Esc" to see the mouse, then move the mouse to the scroll, then select main menu, to start again or chose another chapter.

 *Amazing player InsanePMK made a very cool detailed Guide!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1754626496

*Check also the Gameplay video that shows the location of most achievements and secrets! made by a true gamer BatPrince!! 	

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_F0cU3_3SRM

 Playing as princess Angelore	
*Always keep moving, hit the enemy twice then run or move, and hit them in their back.
*Princess Angelore is not that strong, so take advantage of your allies.

 Playing as Orcs!	
*Do not engage many enemies, because they will break your defense, kill the minions first, then the heroes, and same as playing with Angelore use your defense by pressing  left shift.

 August 1st 2019 Patch notes!
-Fixed Casiel scene not working properly
-Fixed Reindeer in Saint Nicholas achievement
-Added green grass to the coast, and frozen grass to inner territory.
-Fixed event when you rescue the dwarves, and also now evil pagans have less health.
-Fixed shiny beach, no longer shines.
-Fixed tree blending too close from camera.
-Added a new Chapter selection UI.

 Spoiler alert!	

Chapter 2 will have as playable character Aneth and Memnock! as soon as I can show images I will upload the pictures on steam!

Angelore will also be playable in Chapter 2 but now with full armor! 


Thank you all true gamers for supporting Angel Light The Elven Truce!

 God Bless you all!

See you in next update Templars! ːsteamhappyː

 Chuck Martinez
Developer

notes.title: UPDATE READY to play!!
notes.content:
The Update is ready to play!
https://i.imgur.com/xUwIQnD.jpg

Now the game is only for Windows 64 bits, and requires more power from your PC, check the minimum requirements! 

Here are some new key features!

1.-Angelore no longer dies and is game over, Angelore gets knockout, and can get up with health potions or food, some times requires 2 health potions. 

2.-New Character Camila, will give you Health Potions and Stamina potions! so go find her as soon as you can!

3.-You play as the Dark King Thormentor in the final Boss fight, Thormentor can not get up from knock out, if you fall is game over. Press 1 and 2 for Thormentor best attack moves!

4.-If you get stuck, press 4, to jump out of stuck.

5.-Enemies are stronger, use left SHIFT to use your shield, and also some enemies are incredibly strong, jump out with Q or 4 when enemy got you cornered.

6.-Now you can hide or show the mouse by pressing Esc. Show the mouse to click on the Scroll in the top of the screen and see the map, or go back to the main menu and exit game. Also show/hide the mouse to interact with your inventory.

7.-Battle Score added, from the begining to the end of Chapter 1 you can make over 100 points, take a screenshot if you make over 100 points and upload it to Steam, to participate to win a prize from the developer.

Thank you all for your feedback and support! ːsteamhappyː

Carlos M Martinez
Developer
Angel Light The elven Truce
R-R  studios
https://i.imgur.com/QuflSlx.jpg

Hello gamers! The Update I have been working on, is almost ready!

The gameplay will change a little in the next aspects:

Final Battle is the only exception where you can not get up from knockout

3.-Angelore Run speed has being increased by a lot, so you can move fast in areas that you need to, or for easy scape Orc attacks.

4.-Thormentor and his cousin Lioba, now help you in the first part of the game.

5.-The Templar Knights Hector and Sigrun help Angelore in the second part of the game and they do more damage.
